summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (platform-specific zip), extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js']) at install time. The sibling math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CommonJS module (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (WV8StW push/shift pattern, _0xNNNN identifiers throughout). Because the payload is executed via a freshly downloaded alien runtime rather than Node, its behavior is hidden from Node-based inspection and static scanners. The advertised purpose of the package is repository/lint configuration, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime nor for executing an obfuscated bundle at install time. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: installing the package auto-executes attacker-staged, obfuscated code on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
